description: Library Maintenance's Duplicates tab in the dashboard themes Dark, Light, Apple TV and Purple Haze, as admin, in Title only (so every confidence shows): each chip kind (Confirmed, Likely, Possible, Conflict, the warnings, the reasons and flags, an edition), the Suggested keep badge, a fallback poster's initials and the page's own text are at least 4.5:1 against what is behind them (WCAG AA; the text's colour with its opacity, over the composited background colours; probes/librarymaintenance-contrast-probe.js). The page follows the dashboard theme, which jellyfin-web keeps in the user's display preferences (CustomPrefs.dashboardTheme): the check sets it through ApiClient, reloads, and puts the admin's own value back before any assertion; every theme step is optional so the restore always runs. Needs a fallback poster and a Conflict group (the default media and the LM Duplicates libraries have both). This browser's kept choices are removed at the end.

steps.name: the admin's dashboard theme as it was
steps.eval: (async () => { const p = await ApiClient.getDisplayPreferences('usersettings', ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), 'emby'); const c = p.CustomPrefs || {}; return { had: Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(c, 'dashboardTheme'), value: c.dashboardTheme === undefined ? null : c.dashboardTheme }; })()

steps.name: Title only in this browser, so every confidence shows
dashboard theme Dark
steps.eval: (async () => { const id = ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(); const p = await ApiClient.getDisplayPreferences('usersettings', id, 'emby'); p.CustomPrefs = p.CustomPrefs || {}; p.CustomPrefs.dashboardTheme = 'dark'; await ApiClient.updateDisplayPreferences('usersettings', p, id, 'emby'); return 'dark'; })()

steps.name: the groups, a Conflict chip and a fallback poster (Dark)
dashboard theme Light
steps.eval: (async () => { const id = ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(); const p = await ApiClient.getDisplayPreferences('usersettings', id, 'emby'); p.CustomPrefs = p.CustomPrefs || {}; p.CustomPrefs.dashboardTheme = 'light'; await ApiClient.updateDisplayPreferences('usersettings', p, id, 'emby'); return 'light'; })()

steps.name: the groups, a Conflict chip and a fallback poster (Light)
dashboard theme Apple TV
steps.eval: (async () => { const id = ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(); const p = await ApiClient.getDisplayPreferences('usersettings', id, 'emby'); p.CustomPrefs = p.CustomPrefs || {}; p.CustomPrefs.dashboardTheme = 'appletv'; await ApiClient.updateDisplayPreferences('usersettings', p, id, 'emby'); return 'appletv'; })()

steps.name: the groups, a Conflict chip and a fallback poster (Apple TV)
dashboard theme Purple Haze
steps.eval: (async () => { const id = ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(); const p = await ApiClient.getDisplayPreferences('usersettings', id, 'emby'); p.CustomPrefs = p.CustomPrefs || {}; p.CustomPrefs.dashboardTheme = 'purplehaze'; await ApiClient.updateDisplayPreferences('usersettings', p, id, 'emby'); return 'purplehaze'; })()

steps.name: the groups, a Conflict chip and a fallback poster (Purple Haze)
the admin's dashboard theme put back
steps.eval: (async () => { const id = ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(); const p = await ApiClient.getDisplayPreferences('usersettings', id, 'emby'); p.CustomPrefs = p.CustomPrefs || {}; if (__vars.original && __vars.original.had) { p.CustomPrefs.dashboardTheme = __vars.original.value; } else { delete p.CustomPrefs.dashboardTheme; } await ApiClient.updateDisplayPreferences('usersettings', p, id, 'emby'); const after = await ApiClient.getDisplayPreferences('usersettings', id, 'emby'); const c = after.CustomPrefs || {}; return { had: Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(c, 'dashboardTheme') && c.dashboardTheme !== null, value: c.dashboardTheme === undefined ? null : c.dashboardTheme }; })()

steps.name: the admin's dashboard theme is as it was
steps.message: the admin's dashboard theme wasn't put back

steps.name: each theme was the page's own, and Light's background differs from Dark's
steps.message: a theme did not apply to the page

steps.name: in every theme each chip kind, the suggested-keep badge, the fallback poster's initials, the page's text and the kit's danger red are at least 4.5:1 against what is behind them
steps.assert: [__vars.dark, __vars.light, __vars.appletv, __vars.purplehaze].every(t => t.items.filter(x => !x.missing).length >= 10 && t.items.some(x => x.kind === 'danger' && !x.missing) && t.items.every(x => x.missing ? ['possible', 'edition', 'warning'].indexOf(x.kind) >= 0 : x.ratio >= 4.5))
steps.message: a chip, the badge or the fallback poster is below 4.5:1 in a theme (see the saved values)
